Calm, technical Vesna; flat.
Dry deflation of Rook's greed, on-brand.
Precise and mission-first; flat, could use burn-window jargon.
On a lost run it mocks the outcome of the player's performance rather than one of Rook's plans.

items.reason: Dry, hides concern; acceptable.

items.suggestion: Unregistered device detected on claim network. Logging initiated.

items.reason: Cold bureaucratic register is right, but 'Form 27-B' echoes the famous Form 27B/6 from the film Brazil and is close to the vault example 'Notice 7-B'.
items.suggestion: Unregistered console detected. Network access recorded for invoicing.

items.reason: Calls intruders 'valued guests' with a cheerful 'Surprise!', a sarcastic joke toward threats.
items.suggestion: Supply crate breach detected. Contents remain company property.

items.reason: Cold asset language; humour comes from the gap, on-brand.
'Compliance is mandatory' implicitly orders the player to stop, contradicting the objective.
items.suggestion: Security response dispatched. Asset recovery in progress.

items.reason: Cheerful euphemism 'coming to meet you!' toward threats is a joke, not cold bureaucracy.
items.suggestion: Claim security units dispatched to irregularity location.

items.reason: Sarcastic hospitality toward intruders is a joke; the company also frames the Rigs' shuttle as its own service.
items.suggestion: Unregistered craft detected. Departure will be invoiced.
